description: Delete a repository — a SOFT delete (2026-10-19): it disappears at once from git, web, REST, MCP, CI, webhooks, search and pages, its name stays reserved, and it can be restored with gluecron_restore_repo until restorable_until (90 days by default). Queued/running CI is cancelled and pending webhook deliveries are stopped. Only the repository OWNER (the personal owner, or an org owner for an org repository) or a site admin may — admin collaborators and org admins are refused, as in the web UI. Requires 'admin' token scope. Audited as repo.delete; the owner is notified. To remove it for good before then, use gluecron_purge_repo. Returns {deleted: true, soft: true, id, restorable_until}.

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_delete_repo
